pages.name: Variants, the other sections, the phone

artboards.title: As it stands today — the rail is right, its execution is not
Proposed — the same rail, finished: grouped, stateful, and a dialog that never moves
Variants — twenty-four rows in a fixed pane, and nothing else moves
Photo chosen · Markup · Agent share · nothing set, and a refused save
The phone — the rail becomes a list you push into

annotations.text:
The correction, and what it changed.

The first pass deleted the rail and folded three sections into one expanding row. That was wrong: an accordion gets worse as the form grows, and it is exactly the wrong shape for a product with twenty-four variants.

The rail was never the fault. Its faults were: five doors with equal billing, state chips that said "Named" instead of the name, the heading written twice, and a body that leapt from 340px on Markup to 900px on Variants. All four are fixed here without losing the one thing sections are for — seeing only what you need at a go.

One dialog size, on every section: 1040 wide, min(760, 100vh − 96) tall.

That single decision is what makes sections feel professional rather than fidgety. The rail, the head and Save never move; only the pane's contents change, and a pane that needs more room scrolls inside itself.

The cost is honest: the shortest section, Basics, has slack at the bottom of its pane. A dialog that holds its frame is worth more than a dialog that fits each pane exactly and jumps between them.

The section the old form handled worst: twenty-four stacked cards, 410px each, roughly 9,800px of scroll inside a modal that grew to hold them. Here the table scrolls inside a fixed pane under a header that stays put, a filter sits in the panel head at no cost in height, and a variant's own photo is finally settable — from its own row.

Secondary, by the owner's own account — the desktop is where products get added. It is drawn to prove the decisions survive a switch rather than a reflow: the rail becomes a list you push into, keeping the same grammar, and every section still says what it holds before you open it.
